en.headline: State funeral for Tung Chee-hwa proceeds today after Saturday vigil
en.dek: Public memorial and encoffining begin at 9am at Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, with condolence books open until noon at designated centres.
body: The state funeral for Hong Kong’s first chief executive Tung Chee-hwa takes place on Sunday, following an invitation-only vigil held on Saturday afternoon at the Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point.

A public memorial and encoffining ceremony is scheduled to begin at 9am, after which the funeral procession will depart. The rites follow state-funeral standards accorded to former national vice-chairmen, including the draping of the national flag over the coffin.

Members of the public who wish to pay respects may continue to sign condolence books at designated centres until noon today. The centres are located at Morton Terrace Activity Centre in Causeway Bay, Kai Tak Community Hall, and Sai Lau Kok Garden Multi-purpose Activity Room in Tsuen Wan, with an additional temporary point at the North Point Government Offices lobby.
The funeral committee is chaired by a senior central government official, and wreaths from Beijing leaders were received ahead of the service. Tung died on 8 September at the age of 89.

zh.headline: 董建華國葬今日舉行 公祭大殮上午九時開始
zh.dek: 北角香港殯儀館福海堂今日上午九時舉行公祭大殮後出殯，市民可繼續在指定地點簽署弔唁冊至中午。
body: 香港首任行政長官董建華的國葬儀式今日舉行。昨日下午於北角香港殯儀館福海堂進行的設靈屬邀請制，政商界人士到場致祭。
公祭大殮儀式定於上午九時開始，其後出殯。儀式按國家級領導人規格進行，包括以國旗覆蓋靈柩。
市民如欲表達哀悼，可繼續前往指定弔唁處簽署弔唁冊，今日開放至中午十二時。地點包括銅鑼灣摩頓臺活動中心、啟德社區會堂、荃灣西樓角花園多用途活動室，以及北角政府合署大堂的臨時弔唁點。
治喪委員會由中央高層官員擔任主任委員，中央領導亦有致送花圈。董建華於本月八日逝世，享年八十九歲。
